class squirrel.constants.connector.ConnectorFieldSpec(key, label, type='text', required=True, placeholder=None, secret=False)[source]

Bases: object

Describes one config field a connector type collects.

Parameters:

  • key (str) – Key this value is stored under in config.

  • label (str) – Human-readable label for the form.

  • type (str) – One of "text", "password", "number", "textarea".

  • required (bool) – Whether the field must be present on create.

  • placeholder (Optional[str]) – Optional form placeholder text.

  • secret (bool) – If True, this field is encrypted at rest and never returned in plaintext by the API — on read it comes back blank, and on update a blank value means “keep the existing secret” (matching the frontend form’s “leave blank to keep current value” behaviour).
